observation_context.account: authorized test account supplied by the requester
observation_context.method: authenticated browser session; responses read through the same-origin fetch calls the application itself makes
observation_context.sanitization: session cookies, CSRF tokens, JWTs and usernames are not reproduced here; usernames in live responses are already partially masked by the site

lists.number: string or integer, 5 digits, leading zeros preserved when string
lists.bet_category_id: integer (equals the round category id used in the path)

response_shape.sum: string of digits (sum of all submissions in the period)

caching_headers.cache-control: not present on observed JSON responses

endpoints.purpose_inferred: populate the Vue 'ยิงเลข' tab list and running total

lists: array; observed empty for an unprocessed round, otherwise items are mapped client-side to sum and created_at

endpoints.client_usage: main.js maps t.lists to sum values and created_at labels to draw a running-sum chart
endpoints.classification: OBSERVED endpoint and client usage; non-empty payload not observed

request_shape_documented_by_client_bundl.bet_category_id: integer, the current round category id

response_shape_documented_by_client_bund.sum: updated total (string or numeric; client applies parseInt)

endpoints.reason_not_invoked: instructions prohibit automating number submissions or wagering
endpoints.classification: OBSERVED in delivered client code; response contract INFERRED from the code, not executed

endpoints.response_shape: server-rendered page; 50 submission rows per page; header block with ผลรวมยิงเลข, เลขแถวที่ 16, bonus members, ผลรางวัล/สามตัวบน/สองตัวล่าง after publication
server-rendered 88-card grid: .card-items (open/closed pending) and .card-result (published); each card carries data-href to /member/lottery/yeekee/{periodId}
server-rendered results page for all products; for the 88-round Yeekee product only the latest round is shown; the 264-round 'จับยี่กีทันใจ' product shows per-round history for the selected date

websocket.event_handler: GET /member/number-recommend-notified?id=... then shows a PNotify toast and links to /member/number-recommend
websocket.relation_to_round_state: none observed; channel is agent-notification scoped, not round- or result-scoped

polling.update_mechanism: server-rendered page + client countdown; window.location.reload() when the shoot-window countdown goes negative

infrastructure_headers_observed.cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC on member HTML and JSON
infrastructure_headers_observed.static_assets: server: ESF; cache-control: private, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800 (Google Fonts); app assets served from thlotto.com
infrastructure_headers_observed.compression: br for HTML, gzip for some assets
